test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

Can you please make sure that all the **__guest are gathered on__** the stage before the performance begins?
solution:
The correct answer is **"guests are gathered by."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"guest" **should be pluralized to **"guests"** to match the plural form of <
